title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. In this 'quatrième mouture' of Analysis situs, a set L carries 'figures' (also called multistructures). A figure 𝔏 is a family of subsets A ⊂ L, called strata. Each A has a 'open part' A° = A minus the union of the members of 𝔏 strictly contained in A. The previous page checks that the A° are non-empty, pairwise disjoint and cover |𝔏|. The tacit hypothesis appears to be that 𝔏 is stable under intersection, with all A° non-empty.

What the page sets out to do. The (corrected) title is 'Homomorphismes d'immersions et d'applications'. Example 1 builds functoriality of figures under an arbitrary map of sets f : L' → L.

Step 1: the pullback. Formula (1) defines f*: Figures(L) → Figures(L') by
f*(𝔏) = { f^{-1}(A) : A ∈ 𝔏, f^{-1}(A°) ≠ ∅ }.
The condition f^{-1}(A°) ≠ ∅ is equivalent to A° ∩ L_0 ≠ ∅, where L_0 = f(L'). Its role is to discard strata whose open part misses the image, so that pulled-back strata keep non-empty open parts.

Step 2: factorisation into three maps.
(i) 𝔏 ↦ F_{L_0} • 𝔏, a 'trace' or intersection product with the one-stratum figure F_{L_0} = {L_0}. When L' = ∅, F_{L_0} = ∅. This lands in the figures 'situated in L_0'. The text writes Figures(L') → Figures(L')_{L_0}; this is surely a slip for Figures(L) → Figures(L)_{L_0}.
(ii) The canonical isomorphism (***) Figures_{L_0}(L) ≅ Figures(L_0).
(iii) f_0* : Figures(L_0) → Figures(L) for the surjection f_0 : L' → L_0. Because f_0 is surjective, preimage commutes with all Boolean operations and is injective on subsets. So (2) is simply f_0*(𝔏_0) = { f_0^{-1}(A) : A ∈ 𝔏_0 }, and the non-emptiness condition is automatic.

The next page interprets map (i)/(**) as a quotient. One formally sets X = ∅ for every stratum with X° ∩ L_0 = ∅, i.e. one kills a '|∘|-closed' negligible part. It also notes that the composite i_*: Figures(L_0) → Figures(L) is fully faithful with image Figures(L)_{L_0}. This is the classic surjection/inclusion factorisation of pullback, giving a localisation-plus-recollement picture for a combinatorial theory of stratified sets.

Purpose. These are foundational bookkeeping lemmas for a combinatorial or 'tame' analysis situs of stratified sets, in the spirit of the tame-topology programme of the Esquisse.
errors: The first map of the factorisation is written Figures(L') → Figures(L')_{L_0}; it should be Figures(L) → Figures(L)_{L_0} (or Figures_{L_0}(L)).
Formula (2) writes f^{-1}(A_0) with A ∈ 𝔏_0; it should consistently be f_0^{-1}(A) with A ∈ 𝔏_0.

Two facts are used implicitly: that strata of the pulled-back family have open parts f^{-1}(A°), and that A ↦ f^{-1}(A) is injective on the retained strata. Both need 𝔏 to be stable under finite intersections. That hypothesis is not restated on this page. Granting it, the claims are correct.

ideas.what: Pullback of a stratification (figure) along an arbitrary map of sets, discarding strata whose open part misses the image
ideas.modern_name: pullback/restriction of a poset-stratification (stratified sets, Alexandrov-type finite topologies)
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore (stratification theory; Whitney/Thom/Mather for the geometric setting)
ideas.where_published: Possibly related remarks on 'topologie modérée' in Esquisse d'un programme (1984), but not this formalism

ideas.what: Factorisation of pullback as trace on the image, identification Figures_{L_0}(L) ≅ Figures(L_0), and pullback along a surjection
ideas.modern_name: image factorisation (surjection followed by inclusion); i_* fully faithful pushforward along a subset

ideas.what: Viewing restriction to L_0 as a quotient that formally sets negligible strata to ∅ (continued on the next page)
ideas.modern_name: localisation/quotient of a lattice of strata by a downward-closed ideal; recollement-style picture

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries out routine functoriality bookkeeping for Grothendieck's combinatorial 'figures'/multistructures: pullback along a map, factored through trace on the image and pullback along a surjection. It is correct and elementary. The only historically interesting aspect is the general unpublished 1986 Analysis situs project itself, not anything specific to this page.
transcription_corrections: Title: the inserted words above the title read 'de immersions et', making it 'Homomorphismes d'immersions et d'applications'.
First map of the factorisation: the handwriting reads Figures(L…) → Figures(L…)_{L_0}; by context it should be L, not L'.
Formula (2): f_0*(𝔏_0) = { f_0^{-1}(A) | A ∈ 𝔏_0 }, followed by 'la condition f_0^{-1}(A°) ≠ ∅ étant automatique'.
The page numbers at the top (56) and bottom (55) are archive and author numberings; the transcription is fine.
